concept: Secrets Manager: automatic rotation of DB credentials
tests: Choosing a service to store DB credentials with built-in automatic rotation.
expected: AWS Secrets Manager — native rotation (built-in Lambda rotators for RDS and others). Triggers: "rotate automatically every N days", "minimal custom code", "database credentials".
why_not: Parameter Store standard has no built-in rotation; an encrypted S3 object and hardcoded KMS-encrypted credentials require writing rotation yourself.
